question.text: A PM's portfolio has drifted to 75% equity from a 65% target. The appropriate action is:

answer.text: Leave it and hope the market continues
Rebalance by selling some equity and/or buying bonds to restore the 65% target weight

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook defines rebalancing as aligning portfolio weights to the SAA and using thresholds when allocations drift, so restoring the 65% equity target is the prescribed action. The Trap: Leaving the drift in place is style drift; selling the entire portfolio abandons the SAA-based strategy. Note: Per NISM-XXI-B workbook (p.396-397).
